For each \(m=1,\dots,85\), since the sequence is nondecreasing and \(a_{19}=85\), the indices \(i\in\{1,\dots,19\}\) with \(a_i\ge m\) are exactly
\[
b_m,\ b_m+1,\ \dots,\ 19,
\]
so there are \(20-b_m\) such indices.

Counting pairs \((i,m)\) with \(m\le a_i\) in two ways:
\[
\sum_{i=1}^{19} a_i
=
\sum_{m=1}^{85} (20-b_m)
=
85\cdot 20-\sum_{m=1}^{85} b_m.
\]
Thus
\[
\sum_{i=1}^{19} a_i+\sum_{m=1}^{85}b_m=1700.
\]
So the expression is always \(1700\), and the maximum value is

\[
\boxed{1700}.
\]
